$comment: Machine-readable status of every claim Fiorino Quant makes.
Validated by test/fiorino/test_claims_registry.py, which fails when a
claim marked PROVEN names a test that does not exist. A registry nobody
checks becomes a marketing document within one release.
PROVEN              a deterministic test verifies it, and the test can fail
TESTED_BUT_LIMITED  measured on real data, with a stated limit on scope or power
UNTESTED            the code path exists and no test exercises it
DATA_GAP            cannot be tested: the required data does not exist here
NOT_DEMONSTRATED    claimed nowhere; listed so nobody assumes it

claims.claim: Fuzzy matching can never enter the analytic dataset.
claims.evidence: On real names the matcher proposed merging Manchester United with Manchester City at 0.926.

claims.claim: A reader cannot see a result before it settled.
claims.evidence: Property-based over many clocks. Caught a real unbounded read in the M4 engine.

claims.claim: A decision-making package cannot read external history directly.
claims.evidence: A package absent from both role lists fails. The previous guard named odds_snapshots, a table in no migration.
claims.limits: Two BOUNDED_READS exemptions exist, each with a written reason; their safety lives in SQL a future edit could remove.

claims.claim: Only the declared oracle may read a closing price inside a decider.
claims.evidence: The second test exists because the first had a hole: a closing price is also reachable as fair_probabilities filtered to CLOSING.

claims.claim: No timestamp is ever invented for an observation that has none.
claims.evidence: CHECK ((capture_precision = 'TIMESTAMPED') = (captured_at IS NOT NULL)). 37,482 observations, zero invented.

claims.claim: The de-vig records the method actually applied, not the one requested.
claims.evidence: Probing per call was non-deterministic: one rebuild produced SHIN and MULTIPLICATIVE rows, the next only SHIN, from identical input.
claims.limits: In an environment without penaltyblog, every de-vig falls back to multiplicative. The data says so; the numbers differ.

claims.claim: The CLV calibration identity holds under multiplicative de-vig and not under Shin.
claims.evidence: Multiplicative reproduces -ov/(1+ov) to 6.2e-06.

claims.claim: Simultaneous bets are sized against one equity snapshot, never compounded within a cohort.
A two-state EV formula understates a push market's edge by exactly p_push.
claims.evidence: Kelly gives the right stake; the EV is what is wrong.

claims.claim: Yield misleads where CLV does not.
claims.evidence: Validation over 30 strategy-dataset pairs: CLV verdict correct 30/30, yield 23/30. Worst false positive +11.91% yield with CLV -0.0272, t=-11.5.
claims.limits: The 30/30 figure comes from scripts/validate_backtest.py, which fetches from the network and is NOT in the suite. Reproducible, not automatic.

claims.claim: The de-vigged Pinnacle close beats a walk-forward Dixon-Coles fit.
claims.evidence: 10 datasets out of 10, both Brier and log-loss. Mean Brier edge -0.01012.
claims.limits: The suite test runs on ENG_PL 2017-18 only. The 10-dataset result is in scripts/validate_models.py, network-fetching.

claims.claim: A model worse than the market still claims edge on about a third of selections.
claims.evidence: 1,037 of 2,940 selections above 5%, peak +521% EV, CLV negative 30 times out of 30.
claims.limits: The suite test runs on one league-season. The full count comes from scripts/validate_models.py, which fetches from the network and is not part of the automatic suite.

claims.claim: The penaltyblog rho bug is shielded, and counted rather than silenced.
claims.evidence: 82 fallbacks across 311 fits, 44 in one season.
claims.limits: A high fallback rate changes the prediction distribution. Now gated: see C-021.

claims.claim: The blend weight cannot be estimated on matches after its boundary.
claims.evidence: Training and test periods are built with opposite optima: a peeking fitter answers w > 0.9, a correct one w ~ 0.

claims.claim: MARKET + MODEL does not beat MARKET.
claims.evidence: 0 of 10 datasets. All 20 confidence intervals contain zero; 18 of 20 point estimates are worse. Unconstrained optimal weight negative in 5 of 10, to -0.51.
claims.limits: The ablation itself lives in scripts/validate_m6.py, network-fetching. The suite verifies the machinery, not the finding.

claims.claim: A single fitted parameter can improve in-sample and vanish out-of-sample.
claims.evidence: Three datasets gave a training weight of 17-21% and no out-of-sample gain; two of three got worse.
claims.limits: The suite proves only that an in-sample gain cannot be negative, which is arithmetic. The vanishing out-of-sample is measured by scripts/validate_m6.py, network-fetching and not automatic.

claims.claim: The scanner finds a planted bias and does not invent one that is absent.
claims.evidence: A planted 20-point bias is recovered; an arbitrary split is not.

claims.claim: No situational mispricing survives correction for multiple testing.
claims.evidence: 14 situations x 3 selections over 3,502 matches; 0 survive at q = 0.10 with replication in 7 of 10.
claims.limits: MINIMUM DETECTABLE EFFECT 0.039-0.072 probability points. This excludes coarse mispricing, NOT a 2-3 point bias that would be highly profitable.

claims.claim: The favourite-longshot bias is not present in this market.
claims.evidence: The de-vigged price tracks realised frequency in every band from 3% to 85%, max |z| = 1.38. On raw prices the margin rises toward FAVOURITES, not longshots.
claims.limits: Pinnacle 1X2 only. Says nothing about other books or markets.

claims.claim: An event study refuses to run on data without timestamps.
claims.evidence: require_timestamped() raises. The difference-in-differences finds a planted effect and invents none.
claims.limits: Validated on synthetic data only. It has never seen a real information event.

claims.claim: No screen can show a level above WATCH while no strategy is promoted.
claims.evidence: The ceiling is a mechanism, proved by lifting it with a fake promotion. There is no BET level in the code.

claims.claim: A clean clone installs, migrates and serves the dashboard.
claims.evidence: Verified in an empty virtualenv: 19s build, 575 MB peak, all six pages HTTP 200.
claims.limits: In that environment the de-vig is MULTIPLICATIVE, not SHIN. The System page says so.

claims.claim: Lineup publication moves the market beyond its normal movement.
claims.limits: No reachable source carries a lineup publication instant. published_at is NOT NULL with no default, so the schema refuses substitutes.

claims.claim: Market microstructure — speed, breadth, reversal, price discovery — carries exploitable information.
claims.evidence: Ceiling measured: the whole prematch-to-close channel is worth 0.00099 Brier, about a tenth of the model's deficit.
claims.limits: Not one TIMESTAMPED row exists. odds_as_of() is written, tested and never exercised.

claims.claim: xG, injuries, rest, congestion or weather add information to the market.
claims.limits: Never tested. Nothing in M1-M6 bears on it: 'model A plus X gives nothing' does not imply 'any use of X gives nothing'.

claims.claim: The league prior for unseen teams behaves correctly on real data.
claims.limits: Covered by unit tests, but the validation never exercised it: with min_train = 60 every team has played by the first fit. Prior fraction was 0.0% in all 10 datasets.

claims.claim: Asian handicap and totals are correctly priced against a reference close.
claims.limits: 55 selections per fixture are priced and verified internally coherent, but no reference close exists for them in this data, so they are never measured against the market.

claims.claim: Fiorino Quant can make money.
claims.evidence: No strategy has ever produced a positive out-of-sample CLV that was not definitional.
claims.limits: Listed explicitly so that nobody has to infer it from silence.

claims.claim: The betting market prices football matches efficiently.
claims.limits: Measured: THIS model does not beat it, and the close is barely better than the prematch price. Neither is a statement about efficiency.
